title: Dexaflow DAG Specification
description: Canonical serialized representation of a DAG, consumed by the Dexaflow Control Plane.

schema_version.description: Semver of this DAG specification format.

dag_id.description: User-facing DAG identifier. Unique within a tenant.

dag_version.description: Version of this DAG snapshot. Typically a Git tag or build identifier.

schedule.description: Cron expression, preset ('@daily', '@hourly'), or null for manual-only.

min_idle_workers.description: DORMANT seam, not author-settable today: warm workers an author would want kept ready for this DAG version so its tasks skip cold-pod startup (ADR 0058, warm pools). It is absent from the authoring schema (dexaflow.yaml) and the parser never emits it, so a compiled artifact always carries 0. The downstream (EffectiveMinIdle clamp, scheduler store) is intentionally pre-wired, so exposing it to authors later is a schema+parser change only. Would be operator-capped at execution.max_pool_size and inert unless the operator enabled warm pools; 0 (default) means no warmth.

staging.description: Opt-in per-DAG-run shared RWX volume mounted at /staging (ADR 0022).

alerts.description: Native on-failure alerting (#424), overlaid from dexaflow.yaml; the scheduler fires it when the DagRun reaches failed.

variables.description: Airflow Variable names this DAG declares (ADR 0045, ADR 0055). A task receives a Variable only if declared; tasks may narrow further. Absent (empty) declares none.

connections.description: Managed connection ids this DAG declares (ADR 0045, ADR 0055). A task receives a connection only if declared; tasks may narrow further. Distinct from connectors: (pip provider packages, ADR 0038). Absent (empty) declares none.

params.description: Author-declared DAG-run parameters (Airflow's params=), keyed by name. Each provides a default merged into a run's conf and an optional JSON Schema validated against the trigger-time value. Absent declares none (back-compatible).

default.description: Default value merged into a run's conf when the trigger omits this key. Absent means the param is required — the trigger must supply it.

schema.description: JSON Schema the trigger-time conf value is validated against; {} means no constraints.

source.description: Original dag.py source, captured at compile time for the UI Code view.

operator_class.description: For type=airflow_operator: the dotted Airflow operator/sensor class the runtime imports and executes (ADR 0040).

operator_args.description: For type=airflow_operator: the operator's constructor kwargs captured at compile time.

on_failure_callback.description: Marks that the task declares an Airflow on_failure_callback (#424); the runtime runs it in the task process on failure. The callable itself is not carried.

pool.description: The named task pool this task draws a concurrency slot from (Airflow's pool). Empty means the implicit default_pool. Enforced Pro-only (ADR 0053); ignored on Lite.

pool_slots.description: How many slots of its pool the task takes while queued or running (Airflow's pool_slots, ADR 0066). Absent means 1. dexaflow.yaml sets it as size.

execution_mode.description: How a task runs. Every task (python, bash, airflow_operator) runs inside a worker pod via the agent; 'pod' is the only supported value and the default. Retained for forward compatibility.

entrypoint.description: For type=python: 'module.path:callable'. For type=bash: shell command.

env.description: Environment variables for the worker pod / process.

variables.description: Airflow Variable names this task declares, narrowing the DAG-level declaration (ADR 0045, ADR 0055). Absent inherits the DAG's declaration.

connections.description: Managed connection ids this task declares, narrowing the DAG-level declaration (ADR 0045, ADR 0055). Absent inherits the DAG's declaration.

claims.description: Dynamic Resource Allocation (DRA, GA in Kubernetes 1.34): the pod-level resource_claims this container consumes. Each entry names a claim (and optionally a request within it) declared in execution.resource_claims.

execution.description: Executor-specific placement and scheduling hints. Applied only by the Kubernetes executor; ignored by Lite (subprocess, no pods).

priority_class_name.description: Ranks this task pod against neighbors on a shared cluster; the named PriorityClass is platform-owned and cluster-scoped (ADR 0054).

termination_grace_period_seconds.description: Seconds the pod is given to shut down before SIGKILL. Omit for the cluster default (30s).

runtime_class_name.description: Selects an alternate container runtime (e.g. a sandboxed or GPU runtime) registered as a RuntimeClass.

topology_spread_constraints.description: Spread a DAG's task pods across failure domains (zones, nodes). Each entry is a Kubernetes TopologySpreadConstraint.

affinity.description: Pins or repels a task pod relative to nodes and other pods (node/pod affinity and anti-affinity). A Kubernetes Affinity object.

resource_claims.description: Pod-level ResourceClaims for Dynamic Resource Allocation (DRA, GA in Kubernetes 1.34) — e.g. a GPU from a claim template. Each entry is a Kubernetes PodResourceClaim; a container consumes one via resources.claims.

labels.description: Operator-declared pod labels merged onto the task pod. Dexaflow's own leoflow.io/* labels win any key collision.

annotations.description: Operator-declared pod annotations merged onto the task pod. Dexaflow's own task-instance-id annotation wins any key collision.

xcom_input.description: Map of parameter name to ordered list of upstream task_ids whose return values to inject. A 1-element list is the common single-upstream case; longer lists are fan-in (the runtime delivers a JSON array, in declaration order).

call_args.description: TaskFlow literal call arguments captured at compile time (#115). Delivered to the runtime as LEOFLOW_CALL_ARGS_JSON. Each value must be JSON-serialisable; XCom upstreams take precedence at runtime over a same-name literal. Named call_args (not params) to leave Airflow's DAG-run params term free for a future feature.

xcom_schema.description: Optional JSON Schema for XCom output validation.

ephemeral_storage.description: Kubernetes-style node-local scratch limit, e.g. '2Gi'. Bounds writable-layer/emptyDir/log usage so a runaway task cannot evict neighbors under disk pressure (ADR 0054).
